title.quote: Video Killed the HD-Map: Predicting Multi-Agent Behavior Directly From Aerial Images
title.value: Video Killed the HD-Map: Predicting Multi-Agent Behavior Directly From Aerial Images

extractions.description: The paper proposes an aerial image-based map (AIM) representation that replaces manually annotated HD maps for multi-agent trajectory prediction. The AIM is obtained by averaging motion-stabilized drone video frames, and is incorporated into a differentiable driving simulator via a custom image-texture-based differentiable rendering module implemented with PyTorch3D. The ITRA trajectory prediction model is trained separately for vehicles and pedestrians with AIM versus rasterized HD maps on a 5.5-hour proprietary drone dataset, with ablations on traffic light rendering and image quality.
